messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: high tail latency detected for inference-runtime in us-west1. Severity=SEV2. Observe p95 > 3x baseline starting 1860056789. Pager: mira.patel

mira.patel: taking this. pinging oncall and runtime. starting live timeline.

lee.su: oncall SRE here. what's the visible customer impact? any 5xx spikes?

mira.patel: no 5xx spike. p50 from 95ms->140ms, p95 from 320ms->1.2s for /v1/generate. A subset of hosts in pool us-west1-r3 affected. Dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/latency/xyz?from=now-3h

isaac.kim: runtime eng -- earlier today we flipped kernel-selector v3.0.0 in canary then rolled. Change adjusts kernel choice heuristics for fused attention kernels. Rollout logs: /deploys/2025-09-15/selector-3.0.0

carla-ghosh: I can see jaeger traces for the window. Kernel launch spans show a median increase of ~800us and many retries on memcpy. Example span:

```
span_id: b12f8a
operation: gpu_kernel_launch
duration_ms: 2.1 -> 9.5
tags: model=redwood-7b, seq_len=1536
logs: cudaMemcpyAsync wait / stream sync
```

dan.ortiz: collecting host perf counters. quick snapshot from worker-112:

```
CPU ctx switches (vol/invol): 980/310 (baseline ~450/80)
PCIe CRC errors: 7 (baseline 0)
GPU mem copy retries: +35%
GPU util: 60% (baseline 85%)
```

isaac.kim: the selector v3 uses a packing heuristic that sometimes prefers a 'packed' kernel that assumes contiguous buffers. If padding or stride differs, memcpy fallback occurs. Could explain the memcpy stalls.

mira.patel: hypothesis: selector v3 misclassifies padded inputs causing additional device-to-device memcpy / PCIe retries -> stalls -> p95 spike. Alternate hypothesis: host power governor switched to performance->ondemand causing frequency drops under burst.

lee.su: starting trace correlation and will attach sample trace IDs here. Also running `perf stat -e context-switches,cpu-migrations -p <pid>` on affected hosts.

carla-ghosh: reproduced locally by sending sequences with trailing zeros/pad patterns. When selector picks 'kern_pack_v2' we see memcpy fallback. I can patch selector to prefer 'safe' kernel for shapes with trailing zeros. Preparing temp patch.

mira.patel: mitigation plan: 1) pin selector to v2.2.7 on affected hosts 2) drain a portion of r3 pool and redirect traffic to r4 3) notify support and customers. Who can pin now?

isaac.kim: I will pin to v2.2.7 and start rolling the change. Initiating at 1860056890.

runtime-bot: Roll action by isaac.kim: pin selector v2.2.7 -> started 1860056890. Hosts: us-west1-r3.

emma-cs: customer update: a handful of customers reported slower responses, we're sending a note. Draft in #customer-notifications. ETA 15m.

lee.su: after pinning, p95 dropped to ~420ms on canary hosts. Overall fleet p95 trending toward 380ms. Perf counters post-pin look normal: PCIe CRC errors back to 0-1, ctx switches ~520/110.

carla-ghosh: added debug logs in selector: /var/log/runtime/selector-v3-debug.log. Sample lines:

```
[10:12:42] classify: model=redwood-7b, shapes=(1,1536,768), heuristic=pack_score=0.86 -> selected=kern_pack_v2, reason=high_pack
[10:12:42] fallback: memcpy_needed=true, memcpy_ms=7.9
```

mira.patel: good. Dan, can you attach perf dumps and the jaeger spans to the incident artifacts bucket?

dan.ortiz: uploaded /incidents/1860056789/artifacts/perf-worker-112.tgz and jaeger-traces.json. Also saved kernel selector commits and diffs.

isaac.kim: followups: PR with stricter packing threshold and a unit test for trailing-pad cases: https://git.redwood.example/runtime/merge/2001. I'll hold rollout until we have canary gating.

mira.patel: suggested improvement: add canary gating that measures p95 delta vs baseline and blocks rollout if >15% within 10 minutes. Also add alert on PCIe CRC errors > 3 in 5m.

carla-ghosh: I'll own RCA doc and timeline. Will include reproducer script, perf counters, span diffs, commit diffs, and mitigation timeline. ETA preliminary 12h, full RCA 48h.

mira.patel: summary:
- start 1860056789: incident-bot pager
- cause (hypothesis): kernel-selector v3.0.0 picks packed kernel for padded inputs -> memcpy fallbacks and PCIe retries -> increased kernel latency -> p95 regression
- mitigation: pinned selector to v2.2.7 (1860056890), drained/redirected traffic, customer notification
- impact: p95 up to ~1.2s on /v1/generate, no systemic 5xx increase
- next steps: RCA (carla+dan), selector fix + tests (isaac), canary gating and PCIe CRC alert (sre)

runtime-bot: Incident status updated to mitigated at 1860057123. Please upload remaining artifacts to /incidents/1860056789/artifacts.

mira.patel: closing active paging; we'll monitor for 1 hour before closing. thanks everyone.
